The decisive mistake was WebServing_Expert's claim at step 3. The page text from steps 1 and 2 contains no image content, so nothing in it shows which headstone appears behind Dastardly Mash. WebServing_Expert nonetheless named Crème Brulee and quoted its rhyme, with no evidence. The correct answer is "So we had to let it die." The later agents then built on this claim: BenAndJerrysFlavors_Expert asserted an "image check" it never performed, and DataVerification_Expert agreed.
